name: whatsapp-web
description: Use isolated per-chat WhatsApp Web sessions to log in, send messages, set the account profile picture, and receive/process WhatsApp replies via whatsapp-web.js. Recommendation: use a dedicated auxiliary number because WhatsApp Web automation can risk Meta restrictions or bans.

PHONE_NUMBER.prompt: Optional phone number for WhatsApp pairing-code login, including country code.

DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE.prompt: Optional default country code used when normalizing local phone numbers.

HEADLESS.prompt: Run the WhatsApp browser session headless: true or false.

CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH.prompt: Optional path to Chrome/Chromium executable for WhatsApp Web.

IDLE_SHUTDOWN_MS.prompt: Milliseconds to keep an unwatched per-chat WhatsApp session live before closing the browser and reconnecting on demand.

BROWSER_CACHE_MAX_MB.prompt: Maximum discardable Chromium cache usage in MiB before an idle WhatsApp browser is restarted and pruned; authentication and IndexedDB are preserved.

BROWSER_CACHE_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS.prompt: Milliseconds between automatic WhatsApp Chromium cache budget checks.

BROWSER_CACHE_IDLE_MS.prompt: Minimum idle milliseconds before an over-budget WhatsApp browser may restart for cache pruning.

HUMANIZE_SEND.prompt: Whether send mode should wait/show typing before sending by default: true or false.

HUMANIZE_SEND_INITIAL_DELAY_MS.prompt: Milliseconds to wait before showing typing and sending a WhatsApp message.

HUMANIZE_SEND_ONLINE_LEAD_MS.prompt: Milliseconds to appear online before WhatsApp typing starts.

HUMANIZE_SEND_POST_SEND_ONLINE_MS.prompt: Milliseconds to remain online after sending before becoming unavailable.

HUMANIZE_SEND_TYPING_MS.prompt: Milliseconds to show WhatsApp typing before sending a message.

HUMANIZE_SEND_MAX_MS.prompt: Maximum allowed milliseconds for humanized send delays.

WEB_VERSION.prompt: Optional WhatsApp Web version override. Leave empty to use the library default.

WEB_VERSION_CACHE_STRICT.prompt: Whether to require the cached WhatsApp Web bundle for WEB_VERSION: true or false.

INCOMING_BURST_WINDOW_MS.prompt: Milliseconds to coalesce consecutive incoming messages from the same WhatsApp chat before waking Arisa (0-15000).

INCOMING_BURST_BYPASS_NAMES.prompt: Comma-separated names that bypass burst waiting when explicitly invoked.

INCOMING_WAKE_GATE_MODE.prompt: Wake-gate mode for configured WhatsApp resources: off, shadow, or enforce.

INCOMING_WAKE_GATE_RESOURCES.prompt: Comma-separated exact WhatsApp chat or group ids subject to the incoming wake gate.

TRANSCRIBE_AUDIO.prompt: Whether incoming WhatsApp audio/PTT messages should be transcribed before waking Arisa: true or false.

TRANSCRIBE_TOOL.prompt: Tool name used to transcribe incoming WhatsApp audio artifacts.
